workshop_message_precondition.source: Pantheon BFF commit ab3377dcad634ee88ce5ad28c54f657098cda67a strategy-workshop router: GET emits W/"workshop:{id}:vN" as ETag and meta.etag; message mutations reject a missing precondition with 428 and a stale value with 409.
workshop_message_precondition.frontend_behavior: Immediately before each Workshop message POST, StrategyWorkshopPage fresh-reads the canonical Workshop, requires its non-empty BFF-issued meta.etag, and passes the exact value through the client headers option so the generic numeric-lock quoting helper cannot rewrite it. The 202 body is treated only as an event receipt (event_id, sequence_no); StrategyWorkshopPage GETs the canonical events projection and requires the receipt event_id to be present before starting reconstruction.
workshop_message_precondition.hosted_assertion: The strict-live Playwright journey captures the fresh GET and message POST, requires the POST If-Match header to byte-match that GET response ETag, then requires the 202 event_id to occur in a browser-observed GET /events response before the reconstruction POST.
workshop_message_precondition.failure_behavior: A missing ETag, absent event receipt, or absent durable event readback stops before reconstruction and Persona writes; a server 409 stays visible and no fallback or follow-on write is attempted.

hosted_execution_harness.authentication: The workflow verifies BFF operator authority through dev-login, then the browser signs in through hosted GCP Identity with a verified, TOTP-enrolled task account. It does not inject a fixture or synthesize Firebase session storage.
